description: This Java source file defines 'ThingEventAdapter', a class that implements the 'EventAdapter' interface for mapping 'ThingEvent' objects to and from 'Adaptable' representations within a protocol adapter framework. It handles event type identification, message mapping, and topic path construction based on event properties.

classes.name: ThingEventAdapter
classes.description: A final class that adapts 'ThingEvent' objects to external 'Adaptable' representations and vice versa, utilizing mapping strategies and handling event-specific topic path construction.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of 'ThingEventAdapter' with the provided 'HeaderTranslator'.

methods.name: getActionNameWithFirstLetterUpperCase
methods.description: Retrieves the action name from a 'TopicPath' and converts its first letter to uppercase.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Generates a type string for the adaptable based on its topic path and payload.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a 'ThingEvent' to an 'Adaptable' representation, constructing the appropriate topic path, payload, headers, and handling different event types.
